discovery.target_audience: Indian artists, designers, filmmakers, musicians, writers, researchers, craft practitioners.
discovery.visual_mood: Minimalist editorial journal, print-like layout, warm analog feel. No flashy SaaS look, no gradients.

headings.usage: H1-H4. Expressive, tight tracking on large text.

body.usage: Body text, metadata, form labels. High legibility, neutral.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: Flat background (either transparent or white), 1px solid #D8CFC2 border. No drop shadows. Sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-sm max).
surfaces_and_borders.inputs: 1px solid #D8CFC2 border, #F7F2EA or #FFFFFF background. Focus state: 1px solid #1F1F1F, no ring.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D94A2B] text-white hover:bg-[#B83D21] transition-colors rounded-sm px-6 py-2
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#1F1F1F] text-[#1F1F1F] hover:bg-[#1F1F1F] hover:text-white transition-colors rounded-sm

layout_and_spacing.grid: CSS Grid, 12-column foundation. Use gap-8 or gap-12 for generous whitespace. Avoid standard equal squares.
layout_and_spacing.padding: Use generous padding (p-8, p-12) inside major containers to evoke an editorial print layout.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense text and opportunity details. Top-align grid items to avoid jagged content.
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Top bar navigation. Minimalist, transparent or off-white background with 1px bottom border (#D8CFC2). Sticky positioning.

icons_and_assets.style: Minimalist, sharp line icons. 1.5px stroke weight.

images.description: Artisan crafting clay sculpture. Represents physical craft and creation.
Senior artist sketching in studio. Represents deep cultural practice.
Filmmaker camera minimal. Represents digital/film opportunities.
Museum architecture. Represents institutional and residency opportunities.

component_guidelines.tech_stack: React.js (JavaScript, NOT TypeScript), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI.
component_guidelines.shadcn_customization: Strip default borders and radiuses to match the minimal editorial theme. Disable generic box-shadows. Use strict #D8CFC2 for borders.
component_guidelines.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='apply-button').
component_guidelines.opportunity_card: Card layout with top badge (discipline), bold title, grid for details (location, funding, deadline). Display match score with a discreet progress bar or percentage in #D94A2B. Add a prominent 'Save' icon.
component_guidelines.tracker_pipeline: Kanban-style columns (Interested, Preparing, Applied, Accepted, Rejected, Archived) using horizontal scroll on mobile, flex row on desktop. Columns separated by 1px #D8CFC2 border.
component_guidelines.forms: Left-aligned, ample padding. Focus states should shift border color to #1F1F1F, strictly avoiding glow/ring defaults.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all code is written in JavaScript (.js/.jsx), not TypeScript.
Apply data-testid to every button, link, and form input as per requirements.
Set the global background to #F7F2EA and text to #1F1F1F.
Use Cormorant Garamond for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
DO NOT use generic gradients or rounded-xl card designs. Keep borders sharp (rounded-none or rounded-sm) and use 1px solid #D8CFC2.
Build the tracker using a Kanban or dense list structure that feels organized and academic.
For the Digest Builder, provide standard textarea fields with a 'Copy to Clipboard' button (use navigator.clipboard) styled elegantly.
Implement the Impact Dashboard with clean metric cards and minimal bar/line charts using Recharts, colored with the accent (#D94A2B) and muted green (#4F6F52).
Use the provided image URLs in the icons_and_assets section for placeholder content, do not use dummyimage.com.
